answer_1.quote: Explanation. Can a model generate as good an explanation as a human for why a caption-andimage combination is funny?

answer_2.quote: we also report in Appendix E automatic metrics that take into account the human-written reference: (a) using Post (2018)+ROUGE-L ; and (b) word-level perplexity.
